channel.title: Signal
channel.description: Tech news matched to Patrick's interests, curated daily.

item.title: DeepSeek open-sources the architecture behind its super-agent prototype
item.description: DeepSeek published a research prototype of a proactive coding agent that watches repo events and hands off accepted work, built on its plugin-based Harness runtime and flagged as experimental rather than production-ready.

item.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent
item.description: A technical rundown of DeepSeek's MIT-licensed super-agent bundle for Harness, covering its router-worker design, runtime requirements, and how it compares with Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex.

item.title: DeepSeek drops a free coding agent that takes requests from GitHub
item.description: DeepSeek's MIT-licensed dsh-superagent prototype watches a single GitHub repo, takes authorized requests, and answers with proposed code changes or pull requests, with a human-review panel in the loop.

item.title: Speed up local AI on Windows with llama.cpp: MoE offloading and speculative decoding
item.description: Two practical llama.cpp knobs for modest Windows PCs: park MoE expert weights in system RAM with --n-cpu-moe, and pair a small draft model for speculative decoding to lift generation speed.

item.title: DeepSeek's open-source Super-agent prototype takes GitHub requests
item.description: DeepSeek's Harness team published an MIT-licensed prototype that watches repo conversations, picks up coding issues unprompted, and returns fixes as pull requests through a Router-and-Worker design.

item.title: DeepSeek Super-agent prototype: one repo, many parallel coding jobs
item.description: A second look at DeepSeek's Oct 31 prototype: a persistent Router turns authorized GitHub requests into separate Worker sessions, with early simulated tests claiming faster completion than single-session setups.

item.title: Dataiku Headless brings governed data work into agentic coding tools
item.description: Dataiku launches Headless, a plugin letting Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents build and migrate governed Dataiku projects without leaving the editor.

item.title: Clearport runs a local AI chat client entirely on Android via Termux
item.description: Clearport pairs a Flutter chat app with a Termux CLI that serves llama-server on loopback, keeping prompts and models fully on the phone with no account or cloud call.

item.title: Factory ships Droid 1.0, a model-independent coding agent harness
item.description: Droid 1.0 makes programmatic tool calling the default, letting one model request drive hundreds of tool calls through a sandboxed script, and ships as a desktop app, terminal UI, and Node SDK.

item.title: DeepSeek Harness team releases coding agent prototype for GitHub
item.description: An MIT-licensed research prototype puts a resident router over isolated worker sessions to handle permitted requests in a single GitHub repo and return proposed code changes.

item.title: Microsoft opens its Copilot agent harness through Foundry
item.description: Coverage of Microsoft opening the Copilot orchestration harness to outside developers via Foundry, including its sandboxing, MCP support, and the free-until-December pricing window.

item.title: LFM3 runs fully offline on phones through the Private Mind app
item.description: Private Mind, an open-source app, now runs Liquid AI's LFM3 family on iOS and Android entirely offline, with the 1.7B text model reaching about 40 tokens per second on an iPhone 16 Pro.

item.title: WoW: Forever launch times locked in for November 4, with nine new dungeons at launch
item.description: Blizzard's simultaneous global launch lands November 4 at 3pm PT, with nine new dungeons, a level-60 cap, and tier 1 raids unlocking December 9.

item.title: Llama 3.2 3B Goes Local: AMD's Ryzen AI Hybrid ONNX Build Arrives on Modelers.cn
item.description: AMD's quantized ONNX build of Llama 3.2 3B targets Ryzen AI laptops, splitting work between the NPU and CPU for fully on-device inference through ONNX Runtime.

item.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows reaches general availability: keep review in the loop
item.description: GitHub’s open-source project that turns plain-language Markdown task definitions into Actions workflows is now generally available, with read-only defaults and human review kept in the loop before changes land.

item.title: Infini-AI-Lab releases Hermit, an open-source harness adapter framework for AI agents
item.description: Hermit trains a small external adapter that tunes Codex or Claude Code agents to new tasks while leaving both the model and the harness frozen, with local vLLM, SGLang, or Ollama backends.

item.title: Don't expect rapid World of Warcraft: Forever updates as Blizzard confirms post-launch will be 'more laid back'
item.description: Blizzard says WoW Forever will add content roughly every four months after its November 4 launch, deliberately keeping a slower pace than its other games.

item.title: Mistral Large 4 weights are out, with day-one llama.cpp GGUF support
item.description: Mistral's 1T-parameter mixture-of-experts model ships open weights with day-one llama.cpp GGUF builds, a 1M-token context window, and FP8 plus 4-bit variants for local and multi-GPU runs.

item.title: Foundry VTT modules and UVTT files coming for nearly a full map library
item.description: A mapmaker's weekly update promises Foundry modules and UVTT files for almost every map, plus free compendium rules and playable one-to-two-session stories for larger dungeons.

item.title: October 2026 Developer Update
item.description: The Forge's October update recaps its livestream: V14 builds 368 and 369 now available, a demo of Game Environments keeping per-game Foundry setups separate, and a new free BGK board game, reVAMP.

item.title: MCP Suite Pro v1.0.2 aligns LM Studio and Ollama timeouts for large local models
item.description: Small devlog release standardizing local-model timeouts at 300 seconds so heavy quantized weights (14B-70B) finish loading into VRAM without premature HTTP aborts, plus env-var controls for the LM Studio, Ollama, and chat timeouts.

item.title: Cognitum One Unveils MetaHarness, an Open-Source Factory for Agent Harnesses
item.description: Announced at GitHub Universe 2026, MetaHarness generates a branded, governed coding-agent harness from a repo or blank page, with its own CLI, MCP server, scoped memory, and signed releases, while the model stays swappable.

item.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows reaches general availability
item.description: GitHub's open-source project for automating reasoning-based tasks with coding agents inside Actions is now generally available, compiling natural-language Markdown workflow definitions into standard Actions YAML with sandboxed, read-only-by-default execution.

item.title: WoW Forever aims for four-month raid tiers and PC gamepad support at launch
item.description: Blizzard plans a roughly four-month patch rhythm with raid tiers and PvP seasons about three times a year, plus PC gamepad support, while keeping the launch focus on Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.

item.title: Stop Buying GPUs: Turn Your Phone Into eGPU For Local AI
item.description: A walkthrough of running llama.cpp in Termux so an Android phone serves as an offline local AI backend for a PC over USB, including which model sizes fit phone RAM.

item.title: LFM3-1.7B: Best Small LLM is here
item.description: A hands-on look at Liquid AI's 1.7B LFM3 text model, released October 27, covering its 256K context, agentic focus, and how it runs locally on modest hardware.

item.title: NVIDIA Launches Open-Weight Speech Model and 463,062-Hour Audio Dataset
item.description: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe pairs transcription, translation, speaker attribution, and audio Q&A in one open-weight checkpoint that runs on a single GPU, alongside a 463,062-hour open speech dataset.

item.title: Microsoft opens the Copilot Harness to enterprise developers
item.description: Microsoft put the orchestration engine behind GitHub Copilot into public preview via the Foundry Agent Service, offering sandboxed compute, policy controls, and multi-model routing to outside teams.

item.title: Liquid AI LFM3: Why A 1.7B Model Is Now A Business Option
item.description: A look at what makes the 1.7B LFM3 text model practical on-device: about 1 GB at 4-bit, a 256K context window, and single-GPU fine-tuning.

item.title: DeepSeek Harness can delegate tasks to Codex and Claude Code
item.description: DeepSeek's experimental Harness pre-release adds a plugin that hands independent coding tasks to locally installed Codex or Claude Code command-line tools, so the main agent delegates instead of doing every subtask itself.

item.title: Microsoft's Copilot harness opens to outside developers via Foundry
item.description: Microsoft has put the agent loop and sandbox behind Copilot Code, Studio, and VS Code into public preview on Foundry Agent Service, letting developers build agents on the same managed harness while supplying their own instructions, skills, and tools.

item.title: MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 pairs a small document parser with a checker that flags its own mistakes
item.description: OpenBMB's 1.3B parser and 2B checker run locally on one consumer GPU, scoring each parsed region so only uncertain parts need human review.

item.title: Liquid AI releases LFM3: six open-weight 2B models sharing one backbone
item.description: Liquid AI's LFM3 family puts text, vision, audio, omni, and two decision models on a single 1.7B-parameter backbone, with the text model fitting in about 1 GB at 4-bit for on-device use.

item.title: Dataiku launches Headless for agentic coding tools
item.description: Dataiku's new Headless capability lets coding agents build, migrate, and inspect governed data projects from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and similar tools without leaving the editor.

item.title: Small, Fast, Local: MTS AI's Cotype Nano Arrives on Modelers.cn
item.description: A GGUF build of MTS AI's compact Cotype Nano model lands on Modelers.cn, giving llama.cpp, Ollama, and LM Studio users a lightweight local option.

item.title: Codein v1.0.7: lightweight Termux AI terminal agent gets easier to launch
item.description: Termux-based terminal agent launcher update adding AI provider support and chat history, aimed at running AI-assisted terminal workflows on Android devices and modest hardware.

item.title: Epic VTT beta update: repairs and December 1 launch goal
item.description: Browser-based VTT Epic VTT reports beta progress on campaign persistence, multiplayer sync, and permissions as it holds a December 1 public-launch target.

item.title: Llama Guard 3 1B goes local as a GGUF build
item.description: A community GGUF conversion of Meta's 1.2B-parameter Llama Guard 3 safety classifier, packaged for llama.cpp so prompt and output screening can run fully on-device — though it is a mirrored conversion, not an official Meta release.

item.title: OllamaServer: one-click Ollama on Android, no Termux needed
item.description: A new Android app starts the Ollama service with one tap, pulls official models, and accepts custom GGUF uploads, removing the Termux setup step for on-device inference.

item.title: SuperNova-Lite reasoning model arrives as GGUF for local runs
item.description: A community GGUF packaging of Arcee AI's 8B SuperNova-Lite, a DeepSeek-R1-distilled reasoner, sized to run on consumer hardware at roughly 5-6 GB in 4-bit.
